title: field_ops.order.assigned v1
description: Emitted when a field order moves to status='assigned' (a technician was assigned or re-assigned after a failed attempt). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :order, :assigned] telemetry event that Orders.emit_status_event/2 fires after the transition commits. The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data` (telemetry metadata stringified, measurements prefixed with m_).

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the order (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

kind.description: Order kind. Configurable per tenant and context (ADR-127, KindConfigCache), so it is NOT a closed enum.

status.description: New status, always 'assigned' for this event.

previous_status.description: Status before the transition ('created', or 'failed' on a retry).

share_token.description: Public tracking token. It is a credential for the tracking page: consumers must not log it.

tracking_link.description: Public tracking URL built from share_token.
